args.title: Fix duplicate detection for overlapping statement days
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The deduplication process in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` doesn't handle overlapping days when two monthly statements are uploaded together, resulting in duplicate entries for those overlapping days. The deduplication logic needs to be adjusted to correctly identify and handle transactions spanning overlapping days across separate uploads, ensuring all duplicates are accounted for.
